# UPchieve Changelog, week of Aug 8 to Aug 15, 2026

*Generated by Claude from merge-request and commit activity. Details may be inaccurate; check the linked MR or ask the author.*

Last deploys: high-line Aug 13, subway Aug 11.

**Status key:** 🚀 Launched (live to everyone) | 🧪 Experimental (in production, behind a feature flag) | 🎁 Merged (ships next deploy) | ✅ Approved (reviewed, not yet merged) | 👀 In review (needs review)

---

## Student → Volunteer (S2V)

Lets a student become a volunteer coach on the same account, switching modes instead of creating a second one, so they can earn verified volunteer service hours.

- 🚀 **Let the person signing up through a referral link choose their account type.** Which signup flow the link opened was decided by the referrer's legacy role, so a student who later added coach mode could only ever refer students. That blocks an S2V account from becoming an UPchieve ambassador, which is an accolade for recruiting volunteers. The choice now sits with the person signing up rather than the referrer, so recruiters keep one link. 🐛 [#693](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/693): the account-type choice in the signup flow ([high-line !1819](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1819)); `userType` no longer returned by the referring-user API ([subway !2842](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2842)). *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Open the account menu from the caret.** On mobile the IonModal's open state never bubbled up to the Menu component, so the menu did not always close. The caret is now always an activator, any extra open and close controls go through an `isMenuOpen` prop instead of `activatorId`, and the drop-down opens centered on the caret rather than on the block holding the name, account mode, and status. The caret is bold now, and the account menu has hover styles. 🐛 [#688](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/688) ([high-line !1834](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1834)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Keep the ambassador tooltip next to the role it explains.** The "Coach Ambassador" label and its question-mark icon were siblings in the avatar row, and the label was set to `nowrap`, so a narrow sidebar could push the icon away from the text. They share one flex container now, the label wraps instead, and the avatar row is a two-column grid so the menu button keeps a column of its own. ([high-line !1836](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1836)) *Jamie Kasulis*

## Quick wins, fixes, chores, and other small things

- 🚀 **Rename two sidebar links: "Service Hours" is now "Volunteer Hours", and "NTHS Team" is now "NTHS".** The Volunteer Hours link only appears for students in the volunteer-hours rollout ([`show-student-to-volunteer-hours-page`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/706824)); the NTHS rename is live for everyone who has that link. ([high-line !1840](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1840)) *Macy Lam*
- **Students can send an essay in and get written feedback.** Rolled out to no one yet ([`async-essay-review`](https://us.posthog.com/project/1362/feature_flags/806269)): 🧪 the copy now says three coaches will review the essay, on the "How would you like help?" modal and again on the submission page and its confirmation ([high-line !1833](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1833)); 🎁 the same offer made from the Journeys view and from the AI tutor's transfer-to-session step, when the topic is college essays ([high-line !1837](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1837)); ✅ a field for the student's own email address, since several school addresses have bounced ([subway !2857](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2857); [high-line !1838](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1838)). *Trey Stevens, Liseidy Bueno*
- ✅ **Let a coach share a few facts about themselves with the student mid-session.** The coach picks which of their occupation, sessions tutored, students tutored, and hours tutored to share, the choice is kept in browser storage per user, and the student gets a "Learn more about your coach" toggle on the partner panel. The message is relayed over a new socket event to everyone in the session room except the sender. ([subway !2861](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2861); [high-line !1841](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1841)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- ✅ **Columns for the in-app NTHS president application.** `responses` holds the questions and the applicant's answers, `form_version` records which question set they were collected with (`0` predates the in-app form), `unlisted_school` holds the name, city, state, and website of a school we could not match so staff can resolve it to a `school_id`, and `decided_at` and `activated_at` are separate so an approval can be held back and revealed later, with the applicant still seeing pending in between. One pending application per user, and no per-school constraint, since the unique constraint belongs on the chapter. ([subway !2833](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2833)) *Kasozi Wilson*

### Fixes

- 🚀 **Let a member leave an NTHS team without visiting Manage Team first.** The member list is only fetched on that tab, so leaving from anywhere else tried to remove someone from a list that was not there and did nothing. It fetches the members before removing now. 🐛 [#691](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/691) ([high-line !1831](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1831)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Keep the unread-DM filter on when you come back from a session.** `hasUnreadDMs` is in the query now, so the back button returns to the filtered list instead of the main messages page. 🐛 [#657](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/657) ([high-line !1828](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1828)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Remove the college journey modal from the student dashboard.** 🐛 [#666](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/666) ([high-line !1826](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1826)) *Liseidy Bueno*
- 🚀 **Stop alerting a coach to a delayed session that someone else already took.** Sessions held back by the dashboard delay fired their alert and their `SESSION_SHOWN_AFTER_DELAY` event when the timer expired, whether or not the session was still open. The alert and the event now only fire if the session is still in the open list, and the event was renamed to `SESSION_SHOWN_AFTER_DELAY_2` so the old numbers do not mix with the new ones. ([high-line !1830](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1830)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Stop the waiting-student sound for sessions a coach cannot take.** The audio played inside a `try` that also guarded the eligibility check, so the check was doing less than it looked like it was. The ineligible case returns before the sound now. Removing a session from the open list also uses `filter` instead of `findIndex` plus `splice`, and a comment records why a cancelled locked session lingers in the list: it gives the coach a chance to still open it and take the certification quiz. ([high-line !1835](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1835)) *Jamie Kasulis*
- 🚀 **Update a student's SendGrid contact when their grade level changes.** The contact was only created on other profile updates, so a grade-level change left the marketing segments stale. The SendGrid call also moved into a job, out of the request cycle. 🐛 [#685](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/685) ([subway !2854](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2854)) *sammy nave*
- 🚀 **Spell `America/New_York` with an underscore in the NTHS chapter-status job.** `America/New York` is not a valid IANA zone, so moment-timezone silently fell back. Fixed in all three spots, matching every other job in the file. ([subway !2844](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2844)) *Ben Wheeler*
- 🚀 **Inject dev secrets from Doppler instead of copying them into a `.env` file.** Both servers are done now: the Vite server followed the Node server out. You need read access to the 1Password engineering vault and a 1Password CLI login; you do not need a Doppler login. ([high-line !1824](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1824)) *Alex Lindsay*
- **Upload the files a teacher attaches when editing an assignment.** The edit modal accepted attachments and dropped them, because the upload was a separate request from the assignment update. Create and edit run through one upsert on both sides. 🐛 [#653](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/653): 🎁 the front-end `AssignmentService` merged ([high-line !1805](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1805)); ✅ the rest of the stack is approved and waiting to merge, covering the backend upsert query, a `PUT /assignment` endpoint, a separate endpoint for assigning to multiple classes, the file upload folded into the upsert, a check that the teacher owns the class or assignment, the removal of the now-unused methods, and the front end pointed at all of it under a loading overlay. ([subway !2830](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2830), [subway !2835](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2835), [subway !2829](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2829), [subway !2837](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2837), [subway !2836](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2836), [subway !2838](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2838); [high-line !1811](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1811), [high-line !1812](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1812), [high-line !1806](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1806), [high-line !1813](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/application/high-line/-/merge_requests/1813)) *Alex Lindsay*
- ✅ **Compare moderation confidence scores on the scale they actually come back on.** Two thresholds were multiplied by 100 before being compared against a 0-to-1 score, which put them out of reach, so neither filter ever matched: rude gestures against Comprehend's toxicity score ([subway !2845](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2845)), and addresses against the address-detection model's confidence rating ([subway !2846](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2846)). Found while triaging [#668](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/issues/-/work_items/668). *Ben Wheeler*
- ✅ **Let `PGHOST`/`PGPORT` point the db scripts at another database.** The `db:` scripts, `reset_db.sh`, and `.pgpass` hardcoded `localhost:5432`, so with two checkouts running, a migration from the second one quietly landed in the first one's database. `.pgpass` had the port hardcoded too, so it silently failed to authenticate anywhere but 5432 and now wildcards it. Defaults are unchanged. ([subway !2852](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2852)) *Ben Wheeler*
- **Move secret scanning to push time and off `detect-secrets`.** `detect-secrets` rewrote `.secrets.baseline` every time it ran, so the drift landed in the MR alongside the real changes, and it only ever looked at the current state of changed files, which misses a secret that was committed and then removed. Betterleaks scans a range of commits instead, which is what a push needs, and there is no baseline file: everything in the repo is taken as fine as of now. ✅ `secrets:check` moved onto pre-push ([subway !2860](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2860)); 👀 Betterleaks behind the pre-commit and pre-push hooks ([subway !2859](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2859)); 👀 a version-controlled `.githooks` directory replacing the `pre-commit` package, which only ever wrote `.git/hooks/pre-commit` and did not support pre-push at all ([subway !2858](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2858)); 👀 a `bin/jj_pre_push.sh` so jj users get the pre-push hooks too, since jj still has no hook system, invoked through a shell shim they add themselves ([subway !2862](https://gitlab.com/upchieve/subway/-/merge_requests/2862)). *Alex Lindsay*
